name: MAX31855 Amplifier Board
description: The MAX31855 is a cold-junction compensated thermocouple-to-digital converter IC designed for K-type thermocouples. It provides a 14-bit ADC result over a simple SPI interface, making it straightforward to connect a K-type thermocouple to a 3D printer control board. Breakout boards based on this chip are widely available. Klipper supports it directly with the 'MAX31855' sensor type. For multi-type thermocouple support, the more capable MAX31856 is an alternative.
